energy.formula: Wh = assumed attributable watts × sum(API latency milliseconds) / 3,600,000
energy.limitations: Queue/network time is included. Shared NPU utilization, batching and actual hardware power are unknown. These are assumptions, not hardware measurements or a GPU comparison.

avoided_inference: Human-approved fixed opening compiled without inference
Signatures, budgets, exact invoice matching and settlement: zero model calls
Receipt verification and completed-run resume: zero model calls
comparison_claim: No measured claim of general AI superiority. Known fixed source values are validated deterministically.
